THE HEIR IN THE RAIN
EPISODE 4 - "THE GALA"

[00:00] MIRA: But nobody learns my name until the gala.
[00:04] INT. GRAND ORIENT HOTEL - GALA BALLROOM - NIGHT
[00:06] A banner reads "Mehta Group x Rao Shipping - Investors' Gala". Cameras flash.
[00:11] Leela Mehta, dripping in emeralds, greets investors. Arjun and Tanya stand beside her, arm in arm.
[00:17] Mira enters in a midnight-blue gown. Heads turn.
[00:21] MRS. MEHTA: Look who crawled in. Did they hire you to serve the drinks?
[00:26] Guests laugh. A waiter freezes with a tray.
[00:29] Leela takes a glass of red wine from the tray and pours it slowly down the front of Mira's gown.
[00:35] LEELA: There. Now you look like you belong in the kitchen.
[00:39] Tanya films it on her phone, giggling.
[00:42] TANYA: This is going straight to the office group chat.
[00:46] Mira doesn't move. She takes a napkin and calmly dabs her dress.
[00:51] MIRA: You should save that video, Tanya. You'll want to remember tonight.
[00:57] Arjun taps a glass. The room quiets.
[01:00] ARJUN MEHTA: Before the investors arrive, I have an announcement. Tanya and I are engaged.
[01:06] Applause. Tanya holds up her hand. On it is Mira's engagement ring.
[01:11] MIRA: That's my ring.
[01:13] ARJUN: It's my ring. I paid for it.
[01:16] MIRA: (smiling) Congratulations. Enjoy it while it lasts.
[01:21] The lights dim. A spotlight hits the stage. Harish Desai steps up to the microphone.
[01:27] DESAI: Good evening. As you know, the late Vikram Rao owned sixty percent of Rao Shipping and was the Mehta Group's largest investor.
[01:36] DESAI: His will named a single heir. Tonight, that heir takes his seat as chair of the board.
[01:43] Leela straightens her necklace, smiling, sure it's about the Mehta family.
[01:47] DESAI: Ladies and gentlemen, Miss Mira Rao.
[01:51] The spotlight swings to Mira in her wine-stained gown.
[01:54] Leela's champagne glass slips from her hand and shatters.
[01:57] ARJUN: Mira... Rao?
[02:00] Mira walks to the stage. The crowd parts.
[02:04] MIRA RAO: Thank you, Mr. Desai. My father's company has many partners.
[02:10] MIRA RAO: And my first decision as chair... is about the Mehta Group.
[02:16] Leela grips Arjun's arm. Tanya lowers her phone.
[02:20] CUT TO BLACK.
